definitions.explanation: A projectile shot from a bow, consisting of a shaft with a pointed tip.

examples.japanese: {弓|ゆみ}で{矢|や}を{的|まと}に{当|あ}てた。
examples.english: I hit the target with an arrow from a bow.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{弓道|きゅうどう}では、{矢|や}を{射|い}る{姿勢|しせい}や{精神|せいしん}の{集中|しゅうちゅう}がとても{大切|たいせつ}にされている。
examples.english: In Japanese archery, posture when shooting arrows and mental concentration are considered very important.

notes:
{矢|や} is an arrow, shot from a {弓|ゆみ} (bow). Central to {弓道|きゅうどう} (Japanese archery), a traditional martial art.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {矢|や}を{放|はな}つ: to shoot an arrow
- {矢|や}を{射|い}る: to shoot an arrow
- {弓矢|ゆみや}: bow and arrow
- {矢|や}が{刺|さ}さる: an arrow pierces/sticks

IDIOMS AND PROVERBS:
- {矢|や}のように{早|はや}い: fast as an arrow
- {光陰|こういん}{矢|や}のごとし: time flies like an arrow
- {的|まと}を{射|い}る: to hit the mark (figuratively, to make a valid point)

RELATED WORDS:
- {弓|ゆみ}: bow
- {弓道|きゅうどう}: Japanese archery
- {的|まと}: target
- {矢印|やじるし}: arrow sign/symbol (→)
